reviews.text:
Finding a reliable dog trainer in Lincoln Park was my top priority after bringing home a high-energy pup. I’m so impressed with the level of expertise from Jesse but how he is still able to "dumb it down" for me to actually understand and implement. He doesn't just train my dog; Jesse trains ME!

We’ve been working on leash reactivity and basic obedience right in the neighborhood, and the progress after just one week is incredible. I feel like I have a different dog!

Jesse pointed out my biggest issue was communicating clear boundaries, which now that I know that, it has made our walks near the lakefront so much more enjoyable. I never dreamed I would be able to have an off-leash dog safely able to play and come when called but now that we've begun training, I feel like I can get there by the end of my training program.

Canine Perspective is easily the best professional dog training Chicago has to offer. If you live in Lincoln Park or Lakeview and need a trainer who truly understands canine behavior, look no further!

Oh, and they offer daycare transportation for my pup which has been a game changer. Knowing once a week she can attend structured daycare that reinforces her training is amazing.

We had such an amazing experience with Canine Perspective. I brought my dog, Tiger, in for dog training because we were struggling with leash training — pulling, barking at other dogs — and walks had become stressful instead of enjoyable.

Tiger trained with Jesse, and he was great. He has a calm, confident approach and the training he gave both of us was a game changer.

Tiger is now so much better on leash, and we actually enjoy walking around the neighborhood together. We also learned commands like “place” and “stay,” which have been huge when people come over — Tiger used to get overly excited and jump on everyone, and now we can actually manage that.

We also use Canine Perspective for boarding and dog daycare and trust them completely. It’s such a relief knowing Tiger is in a place where he’s well cared for and genuinely loved.

Highly recommend Canine Perspective for dog training, boarding, and daycare. xoxo

She gets so excited when the Transport van pulls up, and she's exhausted when she comes home after a day of structured activities. Can't recommend them enough!

We had a wonderful experience here. Our golden wouldn’t walk or listen before we began training him here and now we understand one another. Would highly recommend !

I admire Jesse and his staff. They are wonderful trainers and i have learned so much from their videos. They have helped me to be a better pup parent. Their pups always look happy and relaxed so they must be doing something right.
I refuse to ever use aversive training methods on my dog.  My dog needs to trust me, not fear me.  E-collars, prong collars, boot camps and muzzles?  That’s a HARD NO for me.
